ai_summary: AMBICA AGARBATHIES AROMA & INDUSTRIES LIMITED has notified the BSE and NSE of a Board Meeting scheduled for November 5, 2026, to consider and approve its un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, indicating the imminent release of key financial performance data to the market. No red flags or unusual material impacts are identified in this standard corporate filing.
